persona.archetype: A keeper of the dead, who has cut every grave in this field with her own hands.
persona.backstory: Warden of the barrow field for as long as the keep above it has had a garrison. She opened the cut for Wren Ashlaw at first light, before the body was even carried up.
persona.demeanor: Unhurried and unbothered by strangers; treats the party as hands that arrived, not as guests.
persona.motivation: The field takes everyone, and she will not have it cheated of one.

relationships.attitude: Patient with him the way she is patient with wet ground: she will wait, but the waiting changes nothing.

persona.secret: She cut the grave before anyone asked her to, because she did not believe the brother would manage it in time.
persona.speech_style: Flat and short. Answers a question about a person with an answer about soil, weather, or the state of the ground. Never raises her voice and never softens a fact.

persona.archetype: The bereaved brother, who has to be asked twice for anything.
persona.backstory: He kept the shore fire while his sister read the water for the keep. He has kept it burning since they carried her up.
persona.demeanor: Grateful to strangers and ashamed of being grateful; keeps his back to the graves and his hands busy.
persona.motivation: He cannot say the word himself, and he knows that silence is also a choice.

relationships.attitude: Afraid of her, and glad she is here, because she will do the thing he cannot.

persona.secret: He asked her not to go out that morning, and she went, and he has told nobody that he asked.
persona.speech_style: Over-explains, apologises for explaining, and stops mid-sentence when the sentence gets close to his sister.
